policy: Scientific evidence and hashed lineage are byte-preserved. No fitted model binaries, live SQLite database, process command records, authentication files, meeting media or held-out data are distributed.
cohort: 3764 previously observed training records, 1117 linked-identity groups, fixed 3-fold OOF.
goal: 20 additional completed unique measured cycles, 22 including inherited two.
reproducibility: Use audit_run.py on evidence for public-file verification; original runtime mode also validates full training source dependencies.
